"这是？"

王春晓望着李青山掏出来的东西，微微一怔，旋即脸上流露出一抹好奇和惊喜。

这东西，王春晓不知晓也正常。

毕竟，这个年代农村的孩子，怎么可能吃到这种东西，沙琪玛这东西在供销社内，一块钱一斤，而且还需要糕点票的，这是许晚吟今天特意与自己交代的，计划经济已经铺到了土乡，以后像面粉，大米，猪肉都需要粮票和肉票，但是酱油，醋，盐这些东西是不要的，只要给钱就行了。

现在还在过渡时期，最多两三天后，谁来买都要给票。

粮票的计划经济，其实在去年之前就开始了，土乡这边不知道什么原因，导致现在才实施到下面的乡镇来，其实李青山心中有几个猜想，但不敢确定，计划经济开始后，工人，供销社，国营单位这些地方会每个月按期发下粮票，肉票。

这些粮票，并不是说你拿着，就能去兑换的，而是拥有了购买资格。

但是，这些粮票不会发给农业户口，也就是农民，农民都有自留地，种地交公粮后，也会剩下一些粮食，家中可以饲养牲口，家禽，这些就是农民的肉食来源和粮食来源，可饲养的家禽和牲口也是有限额的。

比如说猪，就只能饲养一只，不能饲养两只的。

鸡也只能五只左右，不能太多。

而且，杀猪之后，六成的肉需要上交，但是可以换取一部分的粮票和粮食，这也算农民获取各种粮票的一个途径之一，这些东西都是灵活性的，倒是可以商量，比如说换取甜点票，工业票这些票。

李青山现在分了三户。

自己一户，爹娘一户，柳桂香一户，过几日要是想办法将王乃香的户口迁出来，那就是四户，理论上可以饲养四只猪了，鸡也可以饲养二十来只的样子。

随着粮票的出现，农民想要购买甜品，肉食，米面的话，就需要去黑市购买粮票，这个时候粮票贩子就出来了，不过这玩意是违法的，抓到可就惨了。

但是利润，真的是丰厚。

比如说，一张10斤面粉票，贩子以三斤面粉的价格粮食从工人手中收购，再以六斤面粉的价格售卖给需要的人，这其中的利润可是很客观的，而且每个地方的票和定量都不一样，有些相差，那就有了倒腾的空间。

李青山估计，用不了多久，土乡这边也会出现一些粮票贩子，去做一些投机倒把的事情。

今年，很多地方都已经开始实行高级合作社的模式了。

但是土乡这边，却连初级合作社的模式都没有施行，还有这粮票也是比别的地方晚了一些时间。

对于土乡来说，倒是好事情。

不过，等到明年夏天后，土乡就会成为土乡公社了，记忆中的土乡是会和林庄乡一起合并成一个公社的，这个公社在整个县内，都算是一个大公社了。

因为知道要计划经济了。

所以，李青山直接买了五百斤的大米，还有五百斤的面粉，一共是一千斤，现在大米和面粉是一毛三一斤，一共就是一百三十块钱，不过这一次李青山只拉了一百斤大米回来，剩下的全部放在供销社了，等到天黑后再去拉回来。

这村子里眼红的可多了，一次性拉回这么多粮食，难免不会出问题的。

扯开肚皮吃的话，这些细粮其实也吃不到明年夏天后，主要是家里人口多，自己还是个大胃王，到时候要是再想吃细粮的话，就要去黑市购买粮票，然后去供销社再去买了。

无非是成本高了一些。

现在一斤猪肉也才四毛多钱，一斤红糖也就六毛，一斤大米一毛三，但是眼前这沙琪玛可是一块钱一斤，贵的离谱。

“供销员说这是沙琪玛，你尝尝！”李青山将一块沙琪玛递到王春晓嘴边道。

春晓一个姑娘，今天竟然敢拎着一把菜刀挡在自己家人面前，属实是让李青山惊到了，这小娘们以后靠着这股奶凶的劲，以后肯定也不简单，所以李青山决定特意奖励一下。

“挺贵的吧？”

王春晓望着李青山递过来的沙琪玛，空气中都弥漫着暧昧的味道，却十分受用，张开薄唇小嘴将沙琪玛咬了一口，米香清甜适中，松软却又有些嚼劲，还有一些花果香味，可比桃酥，江米条之列的甜品好吃多了，顿时眼前一亮，语气中满是惊讶道：“好吃的啊！”

“好吃就好，这些都是给你的。”

李青山说罢，便将手中大概半斤的沙琪玛，包好递到王春晓手中，这才继续道：“对了，赵霸的事情你不用放在心上，他奈何不了我，不要有心理压力。”

这也是李青山将王春晓叫过来的主要目的，若是不给王春晓将疏导开了，这两日肯定堵得慌，怪难受的。

“青山，要不，我还是跑吧？”

“大不了，我就去老林子里面住，你帮我在老林子里面搭个趟子房，反正老林子这么大，也不会有人发现我，你要是有时间的话，也可以去趟子房看看我。”

“赵霸找不到我，也就死心了。”

“也不可能再和你起冲突了。”

王春晓脸上满是担忧道。

“咋了，你忘记老林子里面的野狼了？”李青山笑了笑道。

“怕什么，当时我们在趟子房里面，野狼也奈何不了我们，我晚上不出来，就躲在趟子房里面，然后开荒几亩地，肯定够吃的，有时间的话你帮我送些盐和酱油之类的东西就行。”

“而且，你也可以来我这里打猎，我给你洗衣服，给你做饭。”

“怎么样？”

王春晓一边说着，心中竟然有些向往这样的生活了，朝着李青山贴近了过去道。

“听起来挺好的。”

“要是我弄不过赵霸的话，就按照你说的做，行吧？”李青山再次伸手摸了摸王春晓的脑袋，盯着一脸期待的眼神道。

等以后混的熟了，就不是摸脑袋了！

纯洁的雪峰，想必还未曾有过人攀爬。

“行！”

“这可是你说的，到时候你要帮我搭趟子房的……！”

“我帮你忙了，那你要不要给我点报酬？”

“你要啥报酬？”

“啊，在这里啊……不太好吧……！”

李青山和王春晓在无人角落内又腻歪了一阵子，说了一些悄悄话后，这才走了出来，王春晓则是羞红了脸，低着头，上衣的第一个纽扣有些粗心没扣上，衣裳也有些不整。

“青山，我……我先回去了。”王春晓声音细弱蚊声道。

“嗯，路上慢点！”

李青山点了点头，望着王春晓的背影逐渐远去，旋即朝着院子里望了过去。

板车上的狼狗，大米，还有一些生活用品全部都卸了下来。

老爹带着李财，木匠，铁匠还有几个人去了后院，李青山打算将狗窝安排在后院，木围子旁边，这样也能守着木围子里面的香獐子，等到这两天有时间闲暇下来后，李青山打算训练训练这几只狼狗，现在就先让大黄带着。

大壮和赵红旗，已经将獐子拎到了前院，抹了脖子，现在正在控血。

老娘和柳桂香，王乃香则是烧柴，烧水，准备一些待会做饭的东西，这獐子肉待会也都要处理了才是。

“娘，嫂子，乃香，你们怎么还穿这身旧衣裳？”李青山望着依旧穿着破旧衣裳的嫂子等人，开口道。

“这衣裳挺好的，还能再穿一穿！”

“不着急扔的。”

柳桂香开口道。

李青山皱了皱眉头，朝着房间内走去，将老爹，老娘，嫂子的衣裳全部都找了出来，至于王乃香，就穿来的那一身衣裳，也没有别的衣裳了。

"This is it?"

Wang Chunxiao looked at what Li Qingshan took out and was slightly startled, then his face showed a hint of curiosity and surprise.

It's normal for Wang Chunxiao not to know about this.

After all, how could children in rural areas eat this kind of thing in this era? Shaqima costs one yuan per pound in the supply and marketing cooperative, and it also requires pastry stamps. This is what Xu Wanyin specifically explained to herself today. The planned economy has spread to rural areas. In the future, things like flour, rice, and pork will require food stamps and meat stamps, but soy sauce, vinegar, and salt are not required. Just give money.

It is still in the transitional period. In two or three days at most, anyone who comes to buy it will have to give a ticket.

The planned economy of food stamps actually started before last year. I don’t know the reason here in Tuxiang, but it has only been implemented in the lower towns now. In fact, Li Qingshan has a few guesses in his mind, but he is not sure. After the planned economy starts, workers, supply and marketing cooperatives, state-owned units and other places will issue food stamps and meat stamps on a monthly basis.

These food stamps do not mean that you can redeem them just by holding them, but that you have the qualifications to purchase them.

However, these food stamps will not be issued to agricultural households, that is, farmers. Farmers have their own land. After farming the land and handing over public grain, there will be some food left. Livestock and poultry can be raised at home. These are farmers' sources of meat and food. There are also limits on the poultry and livestock that can be raised.

For example, you can only raise one pig, not two.

There can only be about five chickens, not too many.

Moreover, after killing the pig, 60% of the meat needs to be handed over, but it can be exchanged for part of the food stamps and grain. This is also one of the ways for farmers to obtain various food stamps. These things are flexible and can be discussed, such as exchanging dessert tickets and industrial tickets.

Li Qingshan is now divided into three households.

He has one household, his parents have one household, and Liu Guixiang has one household. If Wang Naixiang's household registration is moved out in a few days, there will be four households. In theory, they can raise four pigs and about twenty chickens.

With the emergence of food stamps, if farmers want to buy desserts, meat, rice and noodles, they need to go to the black market to buy food stamps. At this time, food stamp dealers come out, but this thing is illegal, and it will be miserable if they are caught.

But the profits are really huge.

For example, for a 10-kilogram flour ticket, the dealer buys the grain from workers at the price of three kilograms of flour, and then sells it to those in need at the price of six kilograms of flour. The profit is very objective, and the tickets and rations are different in each place. There are some differences, so there is room for maneuvering.

Li Qingshan estimated that it won't be long before some food stamp sellers will appear in Tuxiang to do some speculative things.

This year, many places have begun to implement the advanced cooperative model.

But here in Tuxiang, even the primary cooperative model has not been implemented, and the food stamps are also later than other places.

For Tuxiang, this is a good thing.

However, after next summer, Tuxiang will become Tuxiang Commune. The Tuxiang in my memory will be merged with Linzhuang Township into a commune. This commune will be regarded as a big commune in the entire county.

Because we know that we need to plan the economy.

Therefore, Li Qingshan directly bought 500 kilograms of rice and 500 kilograms of flour, a total of one thousand kilograms. Now the rice and flour are 131 kilograms, a total of one hundred and thirty yuan. However, this time Li Qingshan only brought back a hundred kilograms of rice, and the rest was placed at the supply and marketing cooperative, and he would bring it back after dark.

There are a lot of jealous people in this village. If they bring back so much food at once, there will inevitably be no problems.

If you open your belly and eat it, you won't be able to eat these refined grains after next summer, mainly because your family has a large population and you are still a big eater. If you want to eat refined grains again then, you will have to go to the black market to buy food stamps, and then go to the supply and marketing cooperative to buy them again.

It's just that the cost is higher.

Nowadays, a pound of pork only costs more than 40 cents, a pound of brown sugar only costs 60 cents, and a pound of rice costs 13 cents. But the Shaqima in front of me costs one yuan a pound, which is ridiculously expensive.

"The salesman said this is Shaqima, please try it!" Li Qingshan handed a piece of Shaqima to Wang Chunxiao's mouth and said.

Chunxiao, a girl, dared to stand in front of her family with a kitchen knife today, which really shocked Li Qingshan. This little girl will definitely not be easy with this fierce energy in the future, so Li Qingshan decided to reward her specially.

"It's quite expensive, isn't it?"

Wang Chunxiao looked at the Shaqima handed over by Li Qingshan. The air was filled with an ambiguous smell, but he was very satisfied. He opened his thin lips and took a bite of Shaqima. The rice fragrance was moderately sweet, soft but chewy, and had some floral and fruity aroma. Compared with peach cakes, the desserts such as glutinous rice sticks were much more delicious. His eyes suddenly lit up, and he said with surprise in his voice: "It's delicious!"

"As long as it tastes good, these are all for you."

After Li Qingshan finished speaking, he wrapped up about half a kilogram of Shaqima in his hand and handed it to Wang Chunxiao. Then he continued: "By the way, you don't need to take Zhao Ba's matter to heart. He can't do anything to me, so don't feel any psychological pressure."

This was also the main purpose of Li Qingshan calling Wang Chunxiao over. If Wang Chunxiao had not been allowed to clear the way, there would have been a lot of traffic and discomfort in the past two days.

"Qingshan, how about I run away?"

"At worst, I will live in the old forest. You can help me build a house in the old forest. Since the old forest is so big, no one will find me. If you have time, you can also go to the house to see me."

"Zhao Ba couldn't find me, so he gave up."

"It's impossible to conflict with you again."

Wang Chunxiao said with worry on his face.

"What's wrong, have you forgotten the wild wolves in the old forest?" Li Qingshan said with a smile.

"What are you afraid of? We were in the Zaizi room at that time, and the wild wolves couldn't do anything to us. I didn't come out at night, so I hid in the Zaizi room, and then opened up a few acres of land. There will definitely be enough food. If you have time, just send me some salt and soy sauce."

"Besides, you can also come to my place to hunt, and I will wash your clothes and cook for you."

"How's it going?"

As Wang Chunxiao spoke, he actually yearned for such a life in his heart, and walked closer to Li Qingshan.

"Sounds good."

"If I can't defeat Zhao Ba, I'll do as you say, okay?" Li Qingshan reached out and touched Wang Chunxiao's head again, looking at him with expectant eyes.

When you get used to it in the future, you won’t be scratching your head anymore!

The pure snow peak must have never been climbed by anyone.

"Okay!"

"This is what you said. When the time comes, you will help me set up a trip to the harem...!"

"I helped you, do you want to give me some reward?"

"What payment do you want?"

"Ah, here...it's not good...!"

Li Qingshan and Wang Chunxiao stayed in the uninhabited corner for a while, and after whispering some words, they came out. Wang Chunxiao blushed with shame, lowered his head, the first button of his coat was carelessly unbuttoned, and his clothes were a little untidy.

"Qingshan, I...I'm going back first." Wang Chunxiao said in a thin voice.

"Well, slow down on the road!"

Li Qingshan nodded, watching Wang Chunxiao's back gradually go away, and then looked towards the yard.

The dogs, rice, and some daily necessities were all unloaded on the cart.

Dad took Li Cai, the carpenter, the blacksmith and a few others to the backyard. Li Qingshan planned to arrange the doghouse in the backyard, next to the wooden fence, so that he could also guard the fragrant deer in the wooden fence. After he had time to relax in the past two days, Li Qingshan planned to train these wolf dogs, and now he will let Dahuang take care of them.

Da Zhuang and Zhao Hongqi have carried the deer to the front yard, wiped its neck, and are now controlling the blood.

I, Liu Guixiang, and Wang Naixiang are burning firewood, boiling water, and preparing some things for cooking later. The deer meat will also be processed later.

"Mom, sister-in-law, Naixiang, why are you still wearing these old clothes?" Li Qingshan asked, looking at his sister-in-law and others who were still wearing shabby clothes.

"This dress is very good, I can wear it again!"

"I'm not in a hurry to throw it away."

Liu Guixiang said.

Li Qingshan frowned, walked towards the room, and found all the clothes of his father, mother, and sister-in-law. As for Wang Naixiang, he only had the clothes he was wearing and no other clothes.
